name: Codrops
summary: Web design and frontend publication with step-by-step tutorials, live demos and hand-picked showcases of creative websites.
description: A publication for web designers and frontend developers, running since 2009: in-depth tutorials (GSAP, Three.js, WebGL and WebGPU effects, page transitions, cursors, scroll animation) with live demos, plus case studies and designer, developer and studio spotlights. The Creative Hub and Webzibition sections showcase hand-picked websites and demos, some tutorials ship free Astro templates, and downloadable demos are MIT-licensed.
contains: front-end tutorials with live demos and downloadable code
2,409 hand-picked websites in the Webzibition showcase
Creative Hub of Codrops originals and demos
case studies and designer, developer and studio spotlights
free Astro templates such as Isle Thorne Collective and Interlude
curated GSAP and Astro video courses with discount codes
